HasLifecycle.description: Entity progresses through named states — has a status or state column with defined transitions.
property_patterns: status / state column with enumerated lifecycle values

HasMonetaryValue.description: Entity carries financial figures — prices, amounts, revenues, or costs.

HasTimestamp.description: Entity records when events occurred — has at least one temporal column.

aov.description: AVG(orders.total_amount) at order grain. NEVER AVG(order_items.line_total) — that is per-line, not per-order, and undercounts AOV by the average lines-per-order. Cancelled orders excluded by default; on this data excluding them barely moves AOV (cancelled orders are average-sized).

revenue.description: Order-grain booked revenue: SUM(orders.total_amount) over orders not cancelled. Cancelled orders never delivered, so they are excluded by default. Refunded orders WERE fulfilled then reversed — include them in gross booked revenue; exclude them only when net-of-returns is explicitly requested.
